classification: immutable null result: the first SDF diagnostic command-script module nested the already callback-forwarding regular adapter but did not expose those inherited callback names from LLDB's top-level imported module, so execution stopped at the initial prepare_layer entry before the structural selector or any SDF instruction ran

observedFailure.message: structurally selected mask call was not reached

rootCause.description: The directly imported command-script module was capture_prepare_layer_sdf_map_bounds_diagnostic_lldb, while inherited breakpoint callbacks were rebound to functions owned by its nested regular adapter. LLDB stopped without invoking those nested callback names. The established nested-adapter correction is to forward every inherited callback from the directly imported top-level module and rebind dynamically created callbacks after each prepare_layer entry.
